title: Jump rope freestyle: realistic athletic motion
prompt_text:
JUMP ROPE FREESTYLE — REALISTIC ATHLETIC MOTION

TARGET MODEL: Kling 4.0
DURATION: 12 SECONDS
ASPECT RATIO: 9:16 VERTICAL
RESOLUTION: 720P
VISUAL STYLE: Photorealistic natural smartphone video
CAMERA: Static low-angle full-body shot
AUDIO: Natural ambient sound, no music, no dialogue

SCENE DESCRIPTION
A young athletic woman performs an impressive freestyle jump rope routine on an outdoor covered basketball court. She wears a muted sage-green athletic sports bra, fitted black athletic shorts, and clean white sports sneakers. Her long dark hair moves naturally with her body movements. The location is a semi-open sports court with a large corrugated metal roof, visible structural beams, open sides, trees and buildings in the background, and a slightly worn blue basketball court floor.

ACTION & MOTION CHOREOGRAPHY
0–2 seconds — Starting Position
The woman stands upright in the center of the court, holding a jump rope with both hands. She briefly adjusts her hair with one hand, then prepares herself while maintaining a relaxed athletic posture.

2–4 seconds — Rope Activation
She begins rotating the jump rope using coordinated wrist movements. The rope travels in a smooth continuous circular trajectory, passing underneath her feet as she starts jumping rhythmically.

4–6 seconds — Basic Jump Rope
She performs consecutive synchronized two-foot jumps, maintaining a steady rhythm. Her knees bend naturally, her feet leave the ground just enough to clear the rope, and her wrists maintain consistent circular rotation.

6–8 seconds — Alternating Footwork
She transitions into alternating-foot jumps, shifting her weight between her left and right legs. Her footwork becomes more dynamic, with subtle forward and backward steps.

8–10 seconds — Freestyle Combination
She performs a combination of boxer steps, alternating leg lifts, and brief crossover-style footwork while continuously swinging the rope. Her arms coordinate precisely with the rope trajectory.

10–12 seconds — Final Freestyle Sequence
She accelerates slightly into a final combination of alternating jumps and a stylish crossover movement. She briefly lifts one knee, crosses her legs, and lands naturally while continuing to control the rope.

MOTION ACCURACY — CRITICAL
The jump rope must remain physically connected to both handles throughout the performance. Both wrists rotate continuously and naturally to maintain rope momentum. The rope must travel in a believable circular loop around her body. The rope passes visibly underneath both feet during every successful jump. Foot contact, jumping height, landing timing, and rope rotation must be synchronized. No floating rope, broken rope geometry, disappearing rope, or impossible trajectory. Natural human biomechanics and realistic body weight distribution. Smooth transitions between basic jumps, alternating footwork, and crossover movements. Preserve consistent character identity, clothing, body proportions, hairstyle, and environment throughout the entire clip.

CAMERA & ENVIRONMENT
One continuous static camera shot. Low camera placement, slightly looking upward, showing the entire body and the full rope trajectory. No camera cuts, no zoom, no camera shake, and no change in camera position. Natural daylight, realistic shadows, subtle environmental movement, authentic smartphone video quality, realistic skin texture, and accurate motion blur.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
No slow motion, no floating, no teleportation, no extra limbs, no malformed hands, no duplicated rope, no rope passing through the body, no foot sliding, no unnatural jumping, no exaggerated body deformation, no outfit changes, no background changes, no camera cuts, no artificial studio lighting, no cartoon aesthetics."

title: Pixar-style toddler and baby birds tropical forest, 6 scenes
prompt_text: AI Video Prompt    Create a magical, heartwarming, high-quality 3D animated fantasy adventure set in a lush tropical forest filled with warm golden sunlight, vibrant green foliage, and beautiful natural scenery. Scene 1 – The Magical Nest A cute little toddler girl with big expressive eyes and dark brown hair tied in a tiny bun sits inside a large bird's nest resting on a thick tree branch. She is surrounded by adorable fluffy baby birds in different pastel colors, including pink, blue, purple, yellow, and green. A tiny orange crab is sitting beside her. The baby birds cuddle around the little girl as she smiles with excitement. Scene 2 – The Baby Birds Escape Suddenly, the colorful fluffy baby birds begin flying out of the nest, one after another. Their tiny wings flutter rapidly as they float through the air. The little girl looks surprised and excited, watching them leave. The orange crab follows the movement with its curious eyes. Scene 3 – The Adventure Across the Branch The toddler crawls along the large curved tree branch, trying to follow the adorable flying birds. The colorful creatures move ahead playfully, occasionally landing on the branch and looking back at her. Show beautiful close-up shots of their expressive faces and playful reactions. Scene 4 – The Colorful Parade A wide cinematic shot reveals several adorable pastel-colored baby birds lined up along a long tree branch. The little girl watches them with excitement while the tiny orange crab accompanies her. The birds create a magical, colorful visual against the lush forest background. Scene 5 – The Magical Landing The colorful baby birds and the little girl arrive at a huge, soft bed of fluffy white and pink flower petals on the forest floor. The girl joyfully jumps into the soft petals while the adorable birds gather around her. The little orange crab playfully joins them. Scene 6 – The Happy Ending The toddler sits happily among the colorful fluffy baby birds, wearing a beautiful pink floral crown. She laughs with pure happiness as the birds bounce around her. Pink and white flower petals gently fall through the air, creating a magical fairytale atmosphere. Finish with a beautiful wide cinematic shot of the entire group smiling together. Visual Style & Quality: - Premium Pixar-inspired 3D animation. - Extremely cute and expressive characters. - Soft fluffy feathers and realistic detailed textures. - Vibrant tropical forest environment. - Warm golden-hour lighting and cinematic depth of field. - Smooth character animation and natural movements. - Beautiful facial expressions and emotional storytelling. - Magical atmosphere with floating flower petals. - Professional cinematic camera movements. - Consistent character appearance throughout all scenes. Format: 16:9 widescreen, approximately 25 seconds, 30 FPS, ultra-high-quality 3D animated cinematic video. Important: Maintain consistent character designs, natural movement, smooth scene transitions, and a joyful fairytale atmosphere throughout the entire video.

title: Road construction transformation timelapse, 9:16 4K
